连续输入完整拼音：jintianxiawuwomenqubeijing → 今天: Type continuous pinyin, such as jintianxiawuwomenqubeijing. You can select the first word and keep the remaining pinyin. nh suggests 你好; xi'an distinguishes 西安 from 先.
中文打字纠错：字母错序与邻键误触: Chinese typo correction: swapped or neighboring keys
ek 可推荐“可、可以、可是”，ekshi 或 kwshi 可推荐“可是”。根据: ek suggests 可, 可以 and 可是; ekshi or kwshi suggests 可是. Corrects one swap or neighboring-key error using the current layout, frequency and local habits. More complete input is more accurate. Original pinyin stays unchanged until you select a candidate.
hel 可推荐 hello，teh 可推荐 the。点选候选后补一个空格；按空格: hel suggests hello; teh suggests the. Choosing a candidate adds a space. Pressing Space keeps your original word. Names and abbreviations are not forcibly replaced.
记住你确认上屏的词、新词和前后搭配，结合使用次数与最近使用时间调整候选。输入拼音: Remembers confirmed words, new words and word pairs. Frequency, recent usage and the previous word influence ranking. Records stay on this device across app exits, restarts and normal updates; they do not expire or disappear as more words are added. Old habits lose ranking weight, not their records. Ordinary typing does not call your API. Private fields do not learn. Turning memory off pauses learning and personal ranking. Only clearing memory, app data or uninstalling deletes records.
清空用户词库和学习记录: Clear word memory and learning history
永久删除学习过的词、前后搭配和手动添加的词条，无法恢复。清空后会从新输入的词重新: Permanently deletes learned words, word pairs and custom words. This cannot be undone. New typing starts learning again. API and appearance settings are kept.
词库：Rime 袖珍简化字拼音（源自 Android Pinyin IME，Ap: Dictionaries: Rime simplified Chinese pinyin (Android Pinyin IME, Apache 2.0) and SCOWL/ESDB English. Licenses and sources are included. No glide typing, voice input or large-model sentence correction.
选择候选或添加自定义词语后，这里会逐渐积累。: Words accumulate as you choose candidates or add custom words.
中文拼音用空格分隔，英文可留空: Separate Chinese syllables with spaces; optional for English
例如：控机大师 / kong ji da shi。每个汉字对应一个拼音音节。英文: Example: 控机大师 / kong ji da shi. Each Chinese character needs one pinyin syllable. For English, enter the word.
